mascotPrompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Input image: previous gavel concept board, anatomy reference only. Preserve the orange horizontal gavel head, ivory collar and basic face placement, but REDRAW it completely in the retro advertising style specified below. Discard the previous board's tame corporate illustration styling, shading and pose.
Create a beautifully art-directed FoodJury mascot concept sheet, landscape 3:2. FoodJury is a playful mobile app where a judge settles what to eat. This round must bring back the app's original RETRO AMERICAN DINER MEETS COURTROOM identity. This is an expressive 1950s diner advertising character, with original rubber-hose cartoon construction, bold navy ink outlines, huge confident smile, energetic bendy limbs, chunky cream cartoon gloves and oversized diner-era shoes. Restrained flat spot colors: blazing orange #FF6B35, midnight navy #1A1A2E, warm cream #FFF8F0, mustard #FFD23F. Professional crisp drawing, very readable, characterful, beautifully balanced. Tiny screenprint texture only on large board background areas, never dirty on face. No soft 3D shading, no gradients, no modern startup blob mascot, no baby kawaii, no fine wood grain or detailed costume folds. Personality: charming, theatrical, food-loving and a little cheeky. Avoid copying any known character.
Board design: warm cream background, thick navy headline across top, a short orange/navy checkerboard strip at the bottom only, one small mustard starburst. HUGE hero character takes left two thirds. On right one small same-character thinking pose, and below it a clear 180px-looking rounded square app-icon CONCEPT showing only that same character's face on bright orange or mustard. Icon has no text. Leave clean comfortable whitespace; this is a clear brand exploration, not a distressed crowded poster. Tiny labels "THINKING" and "ICON STUDY" under those right-hand elements. Everything aligned and polished.
Text headline verbatim: "D / THE DINER JUDGE"
Hero: A charismatic anthropomorphic orange gavel with an extra-wide rounded mallet head, thick dark expressive arching eyebrows, authentic vintage oval eyes with tiny cream pie-cut highlights, and a broad confident grin. His short handle body wears a very simple midnight navy judge robe with two cream collar tabs. Spaghetti-like arms, oversized cream four-finger gloves, oversized navy shoes with cream sole. He strides jauntily forward, one open glove presenting tonight's options and other hand akimbo. No wig, hat, handheld second gavel, or additional food props. Strong visual rhythm from the oversized head and small body. Clear cartoon gavel silhouette, not a cylinder person. Make the two flared gavel ends simple bold shapes. He belongs on a beloved roadside diner's hand-painted menu and in a delightfully animated food app.
Small thinking pose has a gloved finger on chin and eyebrow arched. Icon study uses his expressive gavel head only, with the cream collar just visible.

Hero: A delightfully opinionated anthropomorphic cheeseburger as a tiny food-court judge. The golden orange top bun IS the face, with just three simple seed marks, expressive tall vintage oval eyes, bold arched eyebrows and a confident huge smile. One navy patty stripe and one mustard cheese corner establish the burger with very few clean layers; no realistic lettuce, ingredients or greasy textures. Beneath the burger, a compact navy cropped judicial robe and oversized ivory two-tab judge collar. Flexible thin navy arms, oversized cream four-finger cartoon gloves, bendy short legs and oversized navy loafers. In one hand a SINGLE tiny wooden-style gavel rendered entirely as flat orange and navy shapes; the other open glove welcomes the user. Jaunty theatrical pose, strong clean readable silhouette. No wig or cap. The face must remain delightful as an icon without the body. App mascot should be as memorable as a great vintage burger-joint mascot, entirely original.
Small thinking pose leans on the gavel with one eyebrow raised. Icon study shows just the bun-face, burger stripe and two collar tabs, no full body.

uiPrompt.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: FoodJury round-two high-fidelity mobile redesign proposal.
Primary request: Bring the real RETRO DINER COURTROOM identity back into this app while making its composition and hierarchy more polished. The previous round was too quiet, generic and modern. This version must have unmistakable fun, retro roadside diner personality.
Input image 1: new retro gavel character sheet, use ONLY the large gavel character as the mascot; keep its identity, bold navy contours, rubber-hose limbs, cream cartoon gloves, cheerful knowing grin and navy judge robe. Do not show the sheet.
Layout: landscape board with exactly THREE large tall mobile screens side by side, straight-on with thin outer device outlines but no hardware, labels above "HOME", "BUILD A CASE", "THE VERDICT". White balance warm cream, no perspective. All screens fit the entire image uncropped.
VISUAL LANGUAGE, essential:
- Saturated blazing orange #FF6B35, deep navy #1A1A2E, cream #FFF8F0, mustard #FFD23F. Orange is a main brand color, not a timid accent.
- Lettering: memorable slanted bold hand-lettered retro diner sign for "FoodJury"; BIG playful condensed all-caps comic/diner lettering like Bangers for expressive headings. A readable friendly rounded sans like Nunito for all body, food names and controls. NO refined editorial serif, NO minimalist luxury restaurant aesthetic.
- Clearly drawn thick 2–3px navy outlines, tasteful solid 3px navy offset shadows on key buttons and food cards. Buttons feel like tactile diner menu labels, not soft app pills.
- A single narrow navy-and-cream checkerboard stripe beneath each compact header anchors the identity. Tiny mustard starbursts only where helpful around mascot or verdict, no clutter.
- Warm clean menu-paper backgrounds. Small ticket-inspired section labels with thin dashed dividers. Mascot humor and a dramatic rubber-stamp verdict moment.
- Strong hierarchy, consistent 22px inner margins, aligned controls, readable body text, 44px+ touch targets. Playful brand with refined layout. Not a messy scrapbook or distressed vintage poster.
SCREEN 1:
Native small status row 9:41.
Compact blazing orange brand header with cream "FoodJury" retro sign wordmark outlined navy, a small simple settings button to right. Checker stripe underneath.
Main cream area: large two-line navy headline "HUNGRY? / COURT'S IN SESSION." Small normal copy "Bring your options. Judge Bite will settle it."
Medium retro gavel mascot in a dynamic welcoming pose, filling center without overwhelming the screen; no big modern rounded hero card. Small comic speech bubble "Order in the kitchen!" and one mustard starburst.
Wide mustard button with thick navy border and hard navy offset, navy text "START A FOOD CASE" and a small gavel icon.
Section "RECENT VERDICTS" as small retro menu subheading. Two tidy rows with square appetizing food photo thumbnails: "Birria tacos" / "Fun · Yesterday", "Salmon bowl" / "Quick · Monday". "View all" secondary link.
Bottom simple two-item nav "Court", "History" on cream with thin navy top separator.
SCREEN 2:
Native small status row 9:41.
Compact orange header with navy back arrow, "NEW CASE" in cream/navy bold diner type, checker stripe underneath.
Large playful navy heading "WHAT'S ON THE MENU?"
Normal short copy "Add 2–5 contenders. Photos are optional."
Two food option cards that resemble clean diner order tickets, cream surface, 2px navy border, tiny flat navy offset shadow, 14px corners. Left photo, right food name, one note, small edit button:
"Birria tacos" / "Crispy, cheesy, a little messy."
"Salmon bowl" / "Fresh, bright, and filling."
Simple dashed outline add row "+ Add another option".
Small label "TONIGHT'S MOOD" followed by a neat 2x2 goal chip group "Fun", "Healthy", "Fit", "Quick". Fun selected mustard with a navy check; other goals cream with navy outlines.
Wide orange main button at bottom with navy outline and hard shadow, dark navy label "LET THE JUDGE DECIDE". Small unobtrusive mascot face beside its label if enough room.
SCREEN 3:
Native small status row 9:41.
Compact orange header with back arrow, "THE VERDICT" in bold cream/navy diner type, checker stripe underneath.
Small mustard angled stamp "CASE CLOSED", large navy diner headline "TACOS WIN!"
Large close-up photo of three crispy birria tacos, consommé and lime on a diner plate, in a strong rounded rectangle with navy border. A small orange stamp partly crosses its edge reading "APPROVED".
Cream order-ticket style explanation block beneath photo with small celebrating gavel mascot on left and "Judge Bite's ruling" bold sans. Body: "Crispy edges, rich flavor, and a little mess. Tonight calls for tacos." Tiny mustard tag "Best for Fun".
Quiet row "See the other option" with chevron.
Wide mustard button with navy outline, navy hard shadow, dark navy label "SHARE VERDICT".
Below small secondary text "Start another case".
This is a conceptual product image with fictional food examples, but every screen must feel coherent and usable. Preserve personality throughout. Do not add charts, scores, prices, or unrelated features. All text must fit within screens and be crisp.
